notes: Close call between android-12 and 7.1. android-12 wins on harmony: 1fac2 people hugging (E13, =11, soft blue gradient) and 1fac6 fingerprint (E16, latest) only exist in light blue, and they sit badly next to 7.1's dark-teal busts. With android-12, 1f46a family uses the 2020 neutral two-adults-and-child figures (=11, no border). That also matches the neutral overrides for 1f48f/1f491 in family. If you prefer 7.1 for its blob-era look, 1f46a becomes the Nougat man/woman/boy, which matches the family subgroup. The four E15.1 neutral families exist only as latest keycap tiles, so they're in the redraw backlog. Ideally redraw them as flat two-tone blue silhouettes in the 1f465 style. 1fac2 hugging isn't bordered, but it's gradient-heavy and blurry at 20px, so it could also be redrawn later. ANDROID-16 PASS: android-16 equals android-12 everywhere except 1f46a family, where it equals latest (grey bevelled keycap), so it cannot replace android-12; the four E15.1 neutral families are the same keycap tiles in android-16 and latest, so they stay in no_acceptable_era and the redraw backlog. Recommended unchanged (android-12, matches selection.toml); no overrides. Where android-16 and latest differ: no tile in this subgroup differs. Emoji 18 additions fall through to latest. android-16 before latest: yes (identical art here, so order has no visible effect).
